Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
"Richard L. Kronick" <kron...@gold.tc.umn.edu> writes:

Please don't answer off the top of your head, you can lead newbies into
a hopeless state of confusion.

>On 27 Jan 1995 04:19:09 GMT,
>John Wade Kim <scy...@alpha2.csd.uwm.edu> wrote:

>>I have a couple of questions.
>>
>>1) If a minion is untapped with Haven Uncovered on it, and I attack it with my minion, does it tap?
>>I think so, but I'm not sure. Help?

No. combat does not tap. Acting taps, blocking taps. Nothing else taps
unless a card says so explicitly.

>>2) Can Vast wealth be blocked?
>>No, vast wealth is a master card. You_can_stop it with sudden reversal.

The Action taken with Vast Wealth can be blocked (it has +1 stealth, though)

>>3) Are the Embrace the the Third Tradition:the Progeny the same clan as the Vampires that made them?
>>yes

>>4) If I use wolf claws, and someone else uses skin of night, can I rotschreck(sp?)
>>yes.
>>5) If I block a Vampire Coming out of torpor by itself, Do we combat? or can I just Diablerize?
>>combat

Torpor'ed Vampires cannot enter combat. Ever.
Section 12.3.1 (pg.23): "If this action is blocked, there is no combat, and
the blocking vampire is given the opportunity to destroy the vampire"
